QuestInfo.name: Ariant Winter Preparations
QuestInfo.0: The land of the scorching sun, Ariant, is also preparing for winter. How does such a place prepare for winter? Go see Jiyur at the Town of Ariant.
QuestInfo.1: Jiyur says that Ariant does not have winter. Instead, it endures the scorching sun all year round. However, Ariant exports Fire Sand, a key ingredient in heat packs, to the other cities during the winter. Deliver some Fire Sand to Jiyur.
QuestInfo.2: You delivered the Fire Sand to Jiyur in Ariant, who is poor yet passionate. Perhaps Jiyur will be able to live well this winter by selling the sand...

0.0: What's that blank expression for?\r\n#L0##bWinter here is warm?#l\n#k
0.1: Of course, it's Ariant. There's no winter in the desert. However, winter is important in Ariant. It's the only time we can collect Fire Sand. Fire Sand is shiny red sand that creates heat, and it is a material used in Heat Packs. Ariant exports the Fire Sand to other towns every winter. Collecting Fire Sand is the main source of income for most people in Ariant. Since you're here today, would you like to try collecting some Fire Sand?
